classification: source-backed recipient cache dependency defect; static trace, no rendered reproduction
title: Idle interaction cache skips newly created grass materials
disagreement: Settle written=(position,zeroVelocity). Add a later tier material through actual spawn_tuft_batches; it starts interaction=ZERO. With unchanged interactor next update returns446-453 before iterating material assets, so old materials retain active radius/push while new material remains disabled. Receiver shader branches on interaction.w>0. System order on creation frame may initialize immediately if updater happens after creation and motion cache was not already equal; no guarantee from that, unchanged following update still skips.
qualification: Material addition at idle is an available ordinary scene presentation path; no visual reproduction, universal scene-transition occurrence or promise every scene spawn retains same interactor position. Runtime settings-only dependency is separate conditional extension, no producer asserted.
connected_repair: Initialize each newly added material from current canonical smoothed interaction, or include recipient/material generation in invalidation; keep position/velocity tolerance, temporal smoothing and no-interactor clearing. Avoid treating per-material missing uniform initialization as separate gameplay authority.
acceptance: With settled idle interactor, adding an actual grass material cannot leave radius/push disabled after update; movement and no-interactor paths remain coherent for all materials. No tests added/executed.
